segments.text: We created a co-pilot feature for our app prime time. It completes the time sheets for users using data from the Microsoft graph such as emails, teams calls, calendar appointments, to-dos, etc.
And it suggests time sheet entries that will complete your time sheet and the gaps that are in it. So you open a time sheet and from the time sheet, you can open a calendar view.
The calendar view shows the completed time sheet, but we can see there are some gaps in here. You can use the co-pilot feature to suggest time sheet entries that will fill in those gaps.

The time sheet entries will be generated based on data pulled from the Microsoft graph such as calendar appointments, teams, calls, to-dos, emails, etc. You'll get a proposal and you can decide to keep it or discard it.

Then you can look at the entries generated and you can see some additional information with an explanation of why that was suggested. You can then review and adjust and in the end you can submit your time sheet.
